values.value: Contracted prices without source quote line

Finds: SBQQ__ContractedPrice__c records with no SBQQ__OriginalQuoteLine__c reference. Why it matters: Without a source quote line, you can't audit where the contracted price came from. When a customer disputes the price, sales has no record of the original negotiation and the contract becomes indefensible. Suppress a finding: for contracted prices migrated from a legacy system where source-quote linkage was never captured. Note the migration batch. Disable the detector: only if you intentionally create contracted prices manually outside the quote flow. Most orgs should leave this on.
